title: Self-Pay Visit Package Medical-Hold Allowance on Past-Due Installments
content:
**Allowance schedule — medical hold.** A past-due installment of a Self-Pay Visit Package carries a medical-hold allowance only where the package is frozen and the past-due installment fell due on or after the freeze start date: for a freeze whose documented reason is surgery it is **$5.00 for every whole week** (seven calendar days) from the freeze start date to the collection date; for a freeze whose documented reason is injury or illness it is **3 percent of the scheduled share**; in every other case there is no medical-hold allowance.

**How the allowance acts.** The allowance is taken off the scheduled share of the installment being collected — the purchase price divided by the number of installments for an installment that is not the last, or what remains of the purchase price for the last. The allowance is not rounded on its own; the amount collected is rounded to the cent after it is taken off.

**Reading the records**

- *Frozen:* the package's status on its own record is frozen at the time of collection.
- *Freeze start date and documented reason:* as recorded on the package.
- *Fell due on or after the freeze start date:* the installment's due date — the purchase date plus the tier's installment interval for every installment already paid — is the freeze start date or later.
- *Whole weeks:* the calendar days from the freeze start date to the collection date, divided by seven, any remainder of fewer than seven days dropped.

**Condition table**

| Package frozen | Installment fell due on or after the freeze start date | Documented reason | Medical-hold allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | surgery | $5.00 for each whole week since the freeze start date |
| Yes | Yes | injury or illness | 3 percent of the scheduled share |
| Yes | Yes | pregnancy or bereavement | none |
| Yes | No — fell due before the freeze start date | any | none |
| No | — | — | none |

**Hypothetical examples**

- Frozen for surgery, freeze start 20 calendar days before the collection date, installment due after the freeze began: 20 days hold 2 whole weeks, so the allowance is $10.00.
- Frozen for surgery 13 days before collection: 1 whole week, $5.00. Frozen for surgery 6 days before collection: no whole week, $0.00.
- Frozen for injury or illness, scheduled share $588.00: 3 percent of $588.00 is $17.64.
- Frozen for injury or illness, scheduled share $556.20: 3 percent is $16.686, taken off unrounded; $556.20 less $16.686 is $539.514, rounded to $539.51.
